text:
alex: quick flag — hit a weird cluster of 400s this morning. root cause: clients omitting X-Api-Version header are getting routed to v2 and schema validation is rejecting them.
mira: ugh, we thought implicit routing would be safe. how many hits are we talking about?
alex: ~1.2k errors over 10m from a handful of partner apps. mostly older SDKs.
sam: can we fallback to v1 for requests that fail validation instead of 400? that would be least user-visible.
cheng: fallback is tempting but risky: it could hide bugs and create divergence in telemetry. we need a clear signal when that happens.
ana: (devex-bot) suggested migration doc would help — we already have a v1->v2 checklist but it's pretty terse.
alex: idea: pipeline-level compatibility shim that attempts v2, on validation error re-route to v1 and tag the request with header X-Rerouted-From=implicit. emit a telemetry event.
mira: +1 on telemetry. if we add automatic reroute we MUST emit metric and trace span. proposal metrics: api.routing.implicit_reroute.count, api.routing.implicit_reroute.sample_rate, api.request.api_version.missing.count
sam: also add a counter for schema_mismatch_before_fallback to help decide when fallback is masking real regressions.
cheng: implementation notes — at the gateway layer we can do a lightweight validation: required envelope fields and top-level types. cheap check to avoid full model validation cost.
alex: snippet I prototyped:
```
if not req.headers.get('X-Api-Version'):
    try:
        validate_light(req.body, v2_schema)
    except SchemaError:
        emit('api.routing.implicit_reroute.count')
        req.headers['X-Api-Version'] = 'v1'
        req.headers['X-Rerouted-From'] = 'implicit'
```
mira: looks fine. add trace tag `implicit_reroute=true` so trace search works in console.
ana: (devex-bot) I'll draft a migration banner copy for console: "Some clients are still using implicit routing. Update SDKs to set X-Api-Version to opt-in to v2 — see migration guide." Can we show per-organization breakdown?
cheng: yes, we should surface org-level telemetry in the console. dashboard tile: "Implicit routing by org" + link to example queries. panels: % of requests missing header, % rerouted, top 10 client versions.
sam: timeline: short-term opt: add shim + telemetry and a console dashboard within 1 week. medium-term: 30-day warning banner before turning off implicit fallback for any org with >0.5% failures. long-term: 6 months deprecation window.
mira: agree on timeline. question: quota implications. if someone gets rerouted to v1 which is slower, they might hit rate limits differently.
cheng: good call. emit quota-routing.delta metric so Billing can map differences. also tag logs with route variant for postmortem.
ana: I'll coordinate with product (ana) on the wording and cross-check the customer impact comms.
ana: @ana can you review the proposed banner copy and deprecation cadence? we should offer a one-click migration guide link and SDK snippets.
ana: (devex-bot) also recommending a small CLI tool that scans logs for missing headers and prints owners and top-endpoints. could be handy for partners.
ana: ops-bot: can we add an alert: api.routing.implicit_reroute.count > 1000/min for 5m -> page oncall? we don't want a silent mass failure.
ops-bot: (ops-bot) alert rule proposed: team=eng-platform, severity=P2, query="sum(rate(api_routing_implicit_reroute_count[5m])) > 1000" — will create ticket.
sam: next steps: cheng to implement light validator + reroute shim (branch: routing/implicit-shim), alex to add telemetry events & trace tags, nana to prepare console banner and dashboard queries, mira to own rollout plan and comms.
cheng: picking this up after lunch. will include unit tests and an opt-out flag at org level (orgs can force `implicit_routing=false`).
alex: I'll open a PR with the metric names and log schema. PR will include example dashboards JSON for Grafana.
mira: thanks everyone. please add short notes to the rollout doc: SLAs affected? fallback may change p99 for some orgs.
ana: I'll start a short migration guide and ping partners with high traffic.
sam: can we add a quick canary: enable shim for 5% of traffic first and watch metrics for 48h? safer than big bang.
cheng: yes, will bake canary toggle into controller flags.
ana: final ask: add a telemetry tag `implicit_routing_reason` with values like `missing_header`, `validation_error` so we can break down root causes.
alex: agreed. ending thread — will post PR link and follow-up in the kanban ticket. :thumbsup:
